parameters.name: GPUType
parameters.description:
The GPU type. Valid values:
- V100
- A100
- A10
- T4
- P100

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description: The name of the metric to query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupID
parameters.description: The resource group ID. Each resource group has a globally unique resource group ID. You can use the resource group ID to obtain information about the resource group.

parameters.name: TimeStep
parameters.description:
The time step. Default value: 5m. The supported time units are:

- h: hours.

- m: minutes.

- s: seconds.

If the value does not contain a unit, the default unit is s (seconds).

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display non-essential information. Non-essential information currently includes Labels.
Valid values:

false: does not display non-essential information (default value)
true: displays non-essential information
